query_params.name: org
query_params.description: Filter organizations to a specific organization name.

query_params.name: orgID
query_params.description: Filter organizations to a specific organization ID.

query_params.name: userID
query_params.description: Filter organizations to a specific user ID.

GET /orgs/{orgID}/members.summary: List all members of an organization

POST /orgs/{orgID}/members.summary: Add a member to an organization

DELETE /orgs/{orgID}/members/{userID}.summary: Remove a member from an organization

GET /orgs/{orgID}/owners.summary: List all owners of an organization

POST /orgs/{orgID}/owners.summary: Add an owner to an organization

DELETE /orgs/{orgID}/owners/{userID}.summary: Remove an owner from an organization
